_comment: Pricing table for /usage/summary (deploy-side config, not code contract). Rates = currency per unit; copy to VAAS_PRICING_FILE and fill from the provider price list. Local-compute render plane is priced 0.0: render_video per second, render_still per image, render_document per doc. Both the target unit spellings (second/image/doc) and the currently recorded 'render' unit (type-mode video, still, document) are listed so every usage row resolves.
